authority.preregistration_erratum: preregistration section 2 quotes `e9a7b7fe...d853` as the DEV-1000 load-split identity; that value is DEV-100's run identity, carried over by a copy error when the preregistration was drafted. The correct DEV-1000 load-split identity is `8580d199...3c84`, which is what this read pins and asserts, and what the campaign row's split-identity cell carries. The receipt-integrity value the preregistration quotes, `9fb44e33...243b`, is correct. The erratum moves NO sample: the population is the same 1,000 ids under either reading.
authority.statistic_citation: Statistic: paired per-sample BLEND - M0 over the unexposed 500; paired cluster bootstrap (N=10,000, seed 20260807) 90% and 95% CIs; McNemar exact. Lock condition (preregistered): the 90% CI lower bound >= +10 pp -- i.e. not merely "excludes zero" but retains the bulk of the DEV-500 margin (+19.75 pp, CI [+16.5, +23.0]) at double scale. A CI that excludes zero but falls below +10 is recorded as CONFIRMED-BUT-SHRUNKEN and does NOT lock; it returns to iteration.
